text: …　カガミ　ヨ　カガミ！
note: This is the Queen's line to the magic mirror in Snow White, which in Japanese famously begins 鏡よ鏡 ("mirror, mirror"). The bird is parroting its owner.
claim: In Japanese versions of Snow White, the Queen's question to the magic mirror begins 鏡よ鏡.

check.quote: 鏡よ鏡…は英語で何？ … そう、グリム童話「白雪姫」で継母が魔法の鏡に向かってつぶやくあのセリフです。
